📺 YouTube ReVanced (RVX) Builder

A patched version of YouTube with ad-free experience, AMOLED dark theme, and premium features powered by Morphe CLI & Anddea Patches

‎ ## ⚠️ Disclaimer > **I only patch for personal use. Please use at your own risk!** ‎ ## 📌 About This project provides a **YouTube ReVanced** patch that enables an ad-free experience and premium features **without a subscription**. Supports both **ROOT** and **NON-ROOT** versions! 🚀 ‎ ## 🔧 Requirements

🎭 Root Users 🎭

✅ **Required:** > - **KSU / Magisk / Apatch** > - ❌ Do not flash module on **TWRP** or other Custom Recovery! 🛠️ **Minimum Supported Versions:** > - **Magisk**: `24200` > - **KSU**: `11425` ---

🌈 Non-Root Users 🌈

✅ **Required:** > - **GmsCore (MicroG)** → Required for logging into a Google Account > - **YouTube ReVanced (Non-Root Version)** ‎ ## 📥 Download GmsCore/MicroG | Source | Download Link | |---|---| | **MicroG-RE (Morphe)** | 🔗 [Download](https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/releases/latest) | | **MicroG-RE (Better UI)** | 🔗 [Download](http://github.com/wstxda/microg-re/releases/latest) | | **GmsCore from ReVanced** | 🔗 [Download](http://github.com/revanced/gmscore/releases/latest) | | **GmsCore from YT-Advanced** | 🔗 [Download](http://github.com/yt-advanced/gmscore/releases/latest) | > [!NOTE] > Recommended to use MicroG-RE (Morphe)! ‎ ## 🚀 Installation Guide

🎭 Root

1. **Download** the [module](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/releases/latest) (**Root Version**) 2. **Install** via **Magisk** / **KSU** / **Apatch** 3. **Export settings** (Optional) 4. Enjoy ✨ ### 📱 On-Device WebUI Patcher & Native Rust Core (`rvx-daemon`) After flashing the module in **KernelSU**, **APatch**, or **Magisk**: - **KernelSU / APatch**: Tap the **WebUI** button inside the module card. - **Magisk**: Tap the **Action** button in Magisk to open `http://127.0.0.1:8088` in your browser. - **Features**: - ⚡ **Native Rust Multi-Call Engine**: Zero-overhead service, action, installer, uninstaller, and packager. - 💻 **Live Terminal Console**: Real-time streaming Morphe CLI logs. - 🚀 **Instant Hot-Mount**: Bind mount patched APK directly without rebooting. - 📦 **In-Memory ZIP Packaging**: Hyper-fast module compression using native Rust DEFLATE engine. - 💾 **Export Flashable ZIP**: Direct export to `/sdcard/Download/`. ---

🌈 Non-Root

1. **Install GmsCore ([MicroG](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/blob/main/README.md#-download-gmscoremicrog))** 2. **Download & Install [YouTube ReVanced](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/releases/latest) (Non-Root Version)** 3. **Export settings** (Optional) 4. Enjoy ✨ ‎ ## 🛠️ Fix & Problem - If YouTube is having problems (module not working) try to use the action button in magisk (root user). - There have been many reports from some clients about buffering issues and video not playing (only sound). You can try the previous version or try downloading a different [GMS Core](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced#-download-gmscoremicrog) . Every user's situation is different! - FIX Problem for Buffering Issue: Change spoof client — Go to Settings > ReVanced > Misc > Spoof client, and try switching to a different client (e.g., Android VR, iOS, or Android TV). Some clients handle seeking/forwarding better than others. - For Non-Root, if during installation it displays "Package incompatible" or something similar, try uninstalling the old version first and reinstalling it cleanly. - New Issue For Non-Root Devices, If you encounter a "Playback ID: XXXXX" error or experience problems while seeking video, try going to RVX - Misc and disabling the PoToken Provider, then spoofing the video stream with another client. ## 🏛️ System Architecture & Developer Guidelines ### 1. High-Performance Native Rust Core + Ultra-Thin POSIX Bridges Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch root managers strictly require shell entrypoints (`customize.sh`, `service.sh`, `action.sh`, `uninstall.sh`). To combine maximum native execution speed with 100% ecosystem compatibility: - **Zero-Overhead `exec` Bridges**: Each `.sh` file is an ultra-thin 2-line POSIX bridge that immediately replaces the shell process (`exec "$MODPATH/bin/rvx-daemon" `) in kernel space. - **Rust Subcommands**: - `rvx-daemon service` : Boot-completed detection, auto-sync version, SELinux labelling, bind mount, background WebUI autostart. - `rvx-daemon action` : Terminal status inspector, fast re-mount, and dashboard launcher. - `rvx-daemon install` : Module installation, stock APK staging, unmounting stale mounts, immediate live-mount without rebooting. - `rvx-daemon uninstall` : Clean mount detachment and stock app restoration. - `rvx-daemon pack` : In-memory flashable module ZIP compression via Rust `zip` crate. - `rvx-daemon server` : Axum + Tokio HTTP/SSE WebUI server. ### 2. Modular Design & Strict < 1000 Lines Limit To ensure maximum maintainability and prevent code bloat: - **Strict Line Limit**: All project scripts and code files (`.rs`, `.js`, `.css`, `.sh`, `.bat`, `.py`) **must strictly remain under 1,000 lines of code**. - **Modular JavaScript**: Split cleanly into `web/js/state.js`, `web/js/api.js`, `web/js/ui-morphe.js`, `web/js/ui-wizard.js`, `web/js/ui-tui.js`, and `web/app.js`. - **Modular Stylesheets**: Split cleanly into `web/css/base.css`, `web/css/morphe.css`, `web/css/wizard.css`, `web/css/tui.css`, `web/css/responsive.css`, and `web/style.css`. - **Modular Rust CLI**: Split into `daemon/src/cli/` submodules (`service.rs`, `action.rs`, `install.rs`, `uninstall.rs`, `pack.rs`). ### 3. Universal Multi-Application Support Across All `.mpp` Bundles The patch engine dynamically discovers and supports **every application** packaged within any `.mpp` patch bundle (including YouTube, YouTube Music, Reddit, Twitter/X, TikTok, and arbitrary custom apps): - **Universal Manifest Normalization**: Parses and normalizes diverse manifest schemas (Morphe `targets` array, Anddea/Inotia00 package mappings, and ReVanced lists) with automatic package detection. - **Dynamic Theming & App Cards**: Generates styled Morphe gradient cards and Termux TUI menu items per application with accurate patch counts, target version options, and custom icons. - **Concurrent Multi-App Magisk Bind Mounts**: Mounts all patched applications present in `$MODPATH/app/` (`YouTubeRevanced.apk`, `YouTubeMusicRevanced.apk`, `RedditRevanced.apk`, etc.) into their respective device base APK locations simultaneously. ### 4. Flexible & Unlimited Patch Sources Ecosystem The engine supports unlimited patch sources without hardcoded constraints: - **1:1 Authentic Morphe Sources Sheet**: Mirrors `MorpheApp/morphe-manager` (`01-sources-sheet.jpg`) with source avatars, `Pre-installed`/`Custom` badges, detailed metrics (`Patches ›`, `Version ›`, `Apps ›`), browser launch, refresh, and Material 3 toggles for `Pre-release patches` and `Experimental app versions`. - **Custom Source Addition & Management**: Add any public or private GitHub repository (`owner/repo`) or raw JSON manifest link with persistent `localStorage` storage and live switching. - **Pre-Configured RVX Catalog**: Anddea Patches (`anddea/revanced-patches`), Morphe Official (`MorpheApp/morphe-patches`), Inotia00 RVX (`inotia00/revanced-patches`), and ReVanced Official (`ReVanced/revanced-patches`). - **Termux TUI Native Management**: Add, delete, and switch custom sources seamlessly inside the Revancify-Xisr terminal interface. ### 5. Fresh 5-Step Setup Wizard & Returning User Dashboard Flow The interface features an intelligent adaptive routing system between first-time configuration and subsequent usage: 1. **Fresh Onboarding Setup Wizard (First-Time User)**: - *Langkah 1 (Sumber & Versi Patch)*: Pilih sumber repositori dan versi saluran rilis lengkap dengan tombol info `(i)` catatan rilis resmi (changelog). - *Langkah 2 (Pilih Aplikasi Target)*: Grid pemilihan aplikasi multi-mpp yang adaptif. - *Langkah 3 (Pilih Versi APK)*: Banner hero *Recommended Version* di posisi teratas + accordion penampil seluruh versi lengkap dengan badge status `[Stable]`, `[Beta]`, `[Alpha]`, dan `[Pre-release]`. - *Langkah 4 (Mode Target & Kurasi Patch)*: Sakelar mode cerdas (`Mode Root` vs `Mode Non-Root`) dengan modal konfirmasi interaktif deteksi MicroG/GmsCore + kurasi opsi dinamis tanpa hardcoding. - *Langkah 5 (Build & Selesai)*: Ringkasan konfigurasi, live streaming logs, dan opsi pasang langsung ke Root Manager (APatch/Magisk/KSU/ReSukiSU/KSU-Next) atau unduh ZIP/APK. 2. **Returning User Dashboard (Pembukaan Kedua Kali & Seterusnya)**: - Saat pengguna kembali atau setup telah selesai, aplikasi langsung menyajikan **Full Morphe Dashboard** tanpa langkah wizard. - Kartu aplikasi yang sudah disetup otomatis berstatus `[✓ Configured]` dan dapat langsung di-patch dengan 1-klik *Instant Quick Patch*. - Tersedia tombol `[⚙️ Setup Ulang]` di bilah atas untuk mengulang wizard dari awal kapan saja, serta tombol menu `[⋮ Edit Setup]` di kartu untuk mengedit konfigurasi aplikasi terkait secara independen. 3. **Silent Developer Console**: - Klik 5 kali pada teks status engine di Info Modal `(i)` membuka console pengembang rahasia tanpa toast atau notifikasi publik untuk mengirim trigger rilis ke GitHub Actions secara aman. ## 📜 Sources & References - 🔧 [Revancify Tools](https://github.com/decipher3114/Revancify) - 🔧 [Revancify Xisr Tools](https://github.com/Xisrr1/Revancify-Xisr) - 📺 [YouTube ReVanced Patches](https://github.com/revanced) - 🛠️ [Anddea Patch](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches) - ⚙️ [Morphe CLI](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-cli)
readmeHTML:
📺 YouTube ReVanced (RVX) Builder

A patched version of YouTube with ad-free experience, AMOLED dark theme, and premium features powered by Morphe CLI & Anddea Patches

‎

⚠️ Disclaimer

> I only patch for personal use. Please use at your own risk!

‎

📌 About

This project provides a YouTube ReVanced patch that enables an ad-free experience and premium features without a subscription.

Supports both ROOT and NON-ROOT versions! 🚀

‎

🔧 Requirements

🎭 Root Users 🎭

✅ Required:

> - KSU / Magisk / Apatch

> - ❌ Do not flash module on TWRP or other Custom Recovery!

🛠️ Minimum Supported Versions:

> - Magisk: 24200

> - KSU: 11425

---

🌈 Non-Root Users 🌈

✅ Required:

> - GmsCore (MicroG) → Required for logging into a Google Account

> - YouTube ReVanced (Non-Root Version)

‎

📥 Download GmsCore/MicroG

| Source | Download Link |

|---|---|

| MicroG-RE (Morphe) | 🔗 Download |

| MicroG-RE (Better UI) | 🔗 Download |

| GmsCore from ReVanced | 🔗 Download |

| GmsCore from YT-Advanced | 🔗 Download |

> [!NOTE]

> Recommended to use MicroG-RE (Morphe)!

‎

🚀 Installation Guide

🎭 Root

  • **Download** the [module](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/releases/latest) (**Root Version**)
  • **Install** via **Magisk** / **KSU** / **Apatch**
  • **Export settings** (Optional)
  • Enjoy ✨

    • 📱 On-Device WebUI Patcher & Native Rust Core (`rvx-daemon`)

    After flashing the module in KernelSU, APatch, or Magisk:

  • **KernelSU / APatch**: Tap the **WebUI** button inside the module card.
  • **Magisk**: Tap the **Action** button in Magisk to open `http://127.0.0.1:8088` in your browser.
  • **Features**:

    • - ⚡ Native Rust Multi-Call Engine: Zero-overhead service, action, installer, uninstaller, and packager.

    - 💻 Live Terminal Console: Real-time streaming Morphe CLI logs.

    - 🚀 Instant Hot-Mount: Bind mount patched APK directly without rebooting.

    - 📦 In-Memory ZIP Packaging: Hyper-fast module compression using native Rust DEFLATE engine.

    - 💾 Export Flashable ZIP: Direct export to /sdcard/Download/.

    ---

    🌈 Non-Root

  • **Install GmsCore ([MicroG](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/blob/main/README.md#-download-gmscoremicrog))**
  • **Download & Install [YouTube ReVanced](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced/releases/latest) (Non-Root Version)**
  • **Export settings** (Optional)
  • Enjoy ✨

    • ‎

    🛠️ Fix & Problem

  • If YouTube is having problems (module not working) try to use the action button in magisk (root user).
  • There have been many reports from some clients about buffering issues and video not playing (only sound). You can try the previous version or try downloading a different [GMS Core](https://github.com/Zy0x/YouTube-Revanced#-download-gmscoremicrog) . Every user's situation is different!
  • FIX Problem for Buffering Issue: Change spoof client — Go to Settings > ReVanced > Misc > Spoof client, and try switching to a different client (e.g., Android VR, iOS, or Android TV). Some clients handle seeking/forwarding better than others.
  • For Non-Root, if during installation it displays "Package incompatible" or something similar, try uninstalling the old version first and reinstalling it cleanly.
  • New Issue For Non-Root Devices, If you encounter a "Playback ID: XXXXX" error or experience problems while seeking video, try going to RVX - Misc and disabling the PoToken Provider, then spoofing the video stream with another client.

    • 🏛️ System Architecture & Developer Guidelines

    1. High-Performance Native Rust Core + Ultra-Thin POSIX Bridges

    Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch root managers strictly require shell entrypoints (customize.sh, service.sh, action.sh, uninstall.sh). To combine maximum native execution speed with 100% ecosystem compatibility:

  • **Zero-Overhead `exec` Bridges**: Each `.sh` file is an ultra-thin 2-line POSIX bridge that immediately replaces the shell process (`exec "$MODPATH/bin/rvx-daemon" `) in kernel space.
  • **Rust Subcommands**:

    • - rvx-daemon service : Boot-completed detection, auto-sync version, SELinux labelling, bind mount, background WebUI autostart.

    - rvx-daemon action : Terminal status inspector, fast re-mount, and dashboard launcher.

    - rvx-daemon install : Module installation, stock APK staging, unmounting stale mounts, immediate live-mount without rebooting.

    - rvx-daemon uninstall : Clean mount detachment and stock app restoration.

    - rvx-daemon pack : In-memory flashable module ZIP compression via Rust zip crate.

    - rvx-daemon server : Axum + Tokio HTTP/SSE WebUI server.

    2. Modular Design & Strict < 1000 Lines Limit

    To ensure maximum maintainability and prevent code bloat:

  • **Strict Line Limit**: All project scripts and code files (`.rs`, `.js`, `.css`, `.sh`, `.bat`, `.py`) **must strictly remain under 1,000 lines of code**.
  • **Modular JavaScript**: Split cleanly into `web/js/state.js`, `web/js/api.js`, `web/js/ui-morphe.js`, `web/js/ui-wizard.js`, `web/js/ui-tui.js`, and `web/app.js`.
  • **Modular Stylesheets**: Split cleanly into `web/css/base.css`, `web/css/morphe.css`, `web/css/wizard.css`, `web/css/tui.css`, `web/css/responsive.css`, and `web/style.css`.
  • **Modular Rust CLI**: Split into `daemon/src/cli/` submodules (`service.rs`, `action.rs`, `install.rs`, `uninstall.rs`, `pack.rs`).

    • 3. Universal Multi-Application Support Across All `.mpp` Bundles

    The patch engine dynamically discovers and supports every application packaged within any .mpp patch bundle (including YouTube, YouTube Music, Reddit, Twitter/X, TikTok, and arbitrary custom apps):

  • **Universal Manifest Normalization**: Parses and normalizes diverse manifest schemas (Morphe `targets` array, Anddea/Inotia00 package mappings, and ReVanced lists) with automatic package detection.
  • **Dynamic Theming & App Cards**: Generates styled Morphe gradient cards and Termux TUI menu items per application with accurate patch counts, target version options, and custom icons.
  • **Concurrent Multi-App Magisk Bind Mounts**: Mounts all patched applications present in `$MODPATH/app/` (`YouTubeRevanced.apk`, `YouTubeMusicRevanced.apk`, `RedditRevanced.apk`, etc.) into their respective device base APK locations simultaneously.

    • 4. Flexible & Unlimited Patch Sources Ecosystem

    The engine supports unlimited patch sources without hardcoded constraints:

  • **1:1 Authentic Morphe Sources Sheet**: Mirrors `MorpheApp/morphe-manager` (`01-sources-sheet.jpg`) with source avatars, `Pre-installed`/`Custom` badges, detailed metrics (`Patches ›`, `Version ›`, `Apps ›`), browser launch, refresh, and Material 3 toggles for `Pre-release patches` and `Experimental app versions`.
  • **Custom Source Addition & Management**: Add any public or private GitHub repository (`owner/repo`) or raw JSON manifest link with persistent `localStorage` storage and live switching.
  • **Pre-Configured RVX Catalog**: Anddea Patches (`anddea/revanced-patches`), Morphe Official (`MorpheApp/morphe-patches`), Inotia00 RVX (`inotia00/revanced-patches`), and ReVanced Official (`ReVanced/revanced-patches`).
  • **Termux TUI Native Management**: Add, delete, and switch custom sources seamlessly inside the Revancify-Xisr terminal interface.

    • 5. Fresh 5-Step Setup Wizard & Returning User Dashboard Flow

    The interface features an intelligent adaptive routing system between first-time configuration and subsequent usage:

  • **Fresh Onboarding Setup Wizard (First-Time User)**:

    • - *Langkah 1 (Sumber & Versi Patch)*: Pilih sumber repositori dan versi saluran rilis lengkap dengan tombol info (i) catatan rilis resmi (changelog).

    - *Langkah 2 (Pilih Aplikasi Target)*: Grid pemilihan aplikasi multi-mpp yang adaptif.

    - *Langkah 3 (Pilih Versi APK)*: Banner hero *Recommended Version* di posisi teratas + accordion penampil seluruh versi lengkap dengan badge status [Stable], [Beta], [Alpha], dan [Pre-release].

    - *Langkah 4 (Mode Target & Kurasi Patch)*: Sakelar mode cerdas (Mode Root vs Mode Non-Root) dengan modal konfirmasi interaktif deteksi MicroG/GmsCore + kurasi opsi dinamis tanpa hardcoding.

    - *Langkah 5 (Build & Selesai)*: Ringkasan konfigurasi, live streaming logs, dan opsi pasang langsung ke Root Manager (APatch/Magisk/KSU/ReSukiSU/KSU-Next) atau unduh ZIP/APK.

  • **Returning User Dashboard (Pembukaan Kedua Kali & Seterusnya)**:

    • - Saat pengguna kembali atau setup telah selesai, aplikasi langsung menyajikan Full Morphe Dashboard tanpa langkah wizard.

    - Kartu aplikasi yang sudah disetup otomatis berstatus [✓ Configured] dan dapat langsung di-patch dengan 1-klik *Instant Quick Patch*.

    - Tersedia tombol [⚙️ Setup Ulang] di bilah atas untuk mengulang wizard dari awal kapan saja, serta tombol menu [⋮ Edit Setup] di kartu untuk mengedit konfigurasi aplikasi terkait secara independen.

  • **Silent Developer Console**:

    • - Klik 5 kali pada teks status engine di Info Modal (i) membuka console pengembang rahasia tanpa toast atau notifikasi publik untuk mengirim trigger rilis ke GitHub Actions secara aman.

    📜 Sources & References

  • 🔧 [Revancify Tools](https://github.com/decipher3114/Revancify)
  • 🔧 [Revancify Xisr Tools](https://github.com/Xisrr1/Revancify-Xisr)
  • 📺 [YouTube ReVanced Patches](https://github.com/revanced)
  • 🛠️ [Anddea Patch](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches)
  • ⚙️ [Morphe CLI](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-cli)
